## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR (single surface, unless genuinely cross-cutting)
- [ ] Tests pass for the surface(s) touched
- [ ] Formatting is clean (`mix format --check-formatted`, or the equivalent for this surface)
- [ ] Commit messages use a conventional prefix (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `chore`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private keys included in the diff
